summary: {person} brings one low-scoring amenity into a meeting about the whole park system.
realLife: Restrooms ranked last among the fifteen categories Seattle residents rated in the city’s park inspection survey.
gates: A survey with separate ratings by amenity and dated responses.
weights: A high overall park rating can conceal a consistently low facility score.
inGame: needs: dated amenity-level responses with district and respondent counts.

turns.what: The board asks for a systemwide response.
turns.pulledBy: Several districts report the same problem.

turns.what: The board asks its superintendent to explain the pattern.
turns.pulledBy: One district accounts for most of the reports.
turns.writesBack: Route the follow-up to that district.
